name: 黄昏：开门前的准备
intro: 黄昏的驿站还未开门。食材送到了，空白的菜单和采购单一起放在桌上。
The waystation is not open yet. The supplies have arrived, and a blank menu lies beside the shopping list.
outro: 菜单与分工已经确定，门牌仍写着尚未营业。晶石的裂痕提醒他们，准备还没有结束。
The menu and duties are agreed, but the sign still says not yet open. The cracked crystal reminds them that their preparations are not complete.
ending: 完成食材核对、试菜与分工；驿站尚未正式营业。守卫带来矿道线索，晶石仍需碎片修复。
dialogue: 旁白
陆川把买来的蔬菜放上厨房桌。门牌还写着尚未营业，艾莉娅展开采购单。
Lu Chuan sets the vegetables on the kitchen table. The sign still says not yet open, and Aelia unfolds the shopping list.
陆川
带去三十枚铜币，食材花了十八枚。剩下十二枚，先留作下一次采购钱。
I took thirty copper coins and spent eighteen on ingredients. The remaining twelve are for our next supplies.
艾莉娅
先把备用金单独放好。今天还没有客人付钱，采购后的余额不能算利润。
Keep that reserve separate. No customer has paid us yet, so the money left after shopping is not profit.
陆川
记住了。先把店准备好，再想营业的事。
Understood. First we prepare the inn, then we think about opening.
艾莉娅
菜单先定三样：蔬菜汤、面包和煎蛋。不接我们做不出来的菜。
Start with three dishes: vegetable soup, bread, and fried eggs. Do not offer food we cannot prepare.
旁白
后门传来敲门声。送货人把面粉袋和鸡蛋篮放在门边，货车停在卸货区。
A knock comes at the back door. The delivery worker leaves flour and eggs beside it, with his cart in the unloading yard.
送货人
面粉两袋，鸡蛋一篮。请先核对数量，签字以后我还要赶下一趟。
Two sacks of flour and one basket of eggs. Please check the quantities before signing. I have another delivery to make.
陆川
两袋面粉、一篮鸡蛋。艾莉娅，先看鸡蛋有没有破，再核对采购单。
Two sacks of flour and a basket of eggs. Aelia, check for broken eggs first, then compare the delivery with our list.
艾莉娅
数量对得上。这几只裂了，先换好再签收，不能混进厨房。
The quantities match. These eggs are cracked; replace them before we sign. They must not go into the kitchen.
送货人
说得对，我从备用篮里换。你们还没开门？
You are right. I will replace them from the spare basket. Are you not open yet?
陆川
还在准备。第一次营业得让人安心，不能先挂招牌再补漏洞。
We are still preparing. Our first service should be reliable. We should not open first and fix problems later.
旁白
送货人换好鸡蛋，带走签过字的收货单。艾莉娅把面粉移到干燥的架子上。
The worker replaces the eggs and takes the signed receipt. Aelia moves the flour to a dry shelf.
艾莉娅
现在试菜。你盛汤，我准备面包，出菜前把要求再说一遍。
Now we test the dishes. You serve the soup, and I prepare the bread. Repeat the request before serving.
陆川
那我先出一道题：一碗不加鸡蛋的汤，两片面包打包。
Here is a practice order: one bowl of soup without eggs, and two slices of bread to take away.
艾莉娅
汤在这里喝，面包打包。先听清楚，比急着端出去更重要。
The soup is eaten here, and the bread is packed. Listening carefully matters more than serving quickly.
陆川
厨房门和柜台之间留出通道，热汤端出来时别碰到搬食材的人。
Keep the passage between the kitchen and counter clear, so hot soup does not collide with someone carrying supplies.
旁白
两人试过一遍出菜路线。桌椅擦净，四张圆桌间留出了足够的通道。
They test the serving route. The furniture is clean, and clear passages remain between the four round tables.
艾莉娅
准备和营业分开记。今晚正式开门前，再检查门锁、灯和食材。
Record preparation separately from service. Before opening tonight, check the locks, lights, and ingredients again.
旁白
巡逻守卫在门口停下，没有进来用餐。他将一张矿道附近的记录交给艾莉娅。
A patrol guard stops at the door without coming in for a meal. He hands Aelia a note about the area near the mine.
守卫
昨晚路障旁出现了陌生脚印。我已经报告值守官，但还没确认来源。
Unfamiliar tracks appeared beside the barrier last night. I have reported them to the watch officer, but their source is still unknown.
艾莉娅
谢谢。我们会提醒路过的人别抄近道，不把猜测当结论。
Thank you. We will warn travelers against the shortcut, without treating a guess as a conclusion.
陆川
晶石还没有亮起来。把桌子摆好，不能直接修好它，对吧？
The crystal has not brightened yet. Arranging the tables cannot repair it, can it?
言契系统
相聚可以稳定封印的能量，碎片才能修复晶石的结构。当前裂痕仍然存在。
Gathering can stabilize the energy of the seal. Fragments are needed to repair the crystal itself. Its crack remains.
旁白
陆川合上采购记录，留下空白的营业页。门牌没有翻动，第一笔订单还在等他们准备好。
Lu Chuan closes the supply record, leaving the sales page blank. The sign stays unchanged; their first order must wait until they are ready.
questions: 预算与营业准备
Why must the twelve remaining coins not be counted as profit?
They were paid by a customer.
They are a reserve from the supply budget, and sales have not begun.
They belong to the delivery cart.
They will repair the crystal.
十二枚是采购预算的余额，尚无营业收入，不是利润。
收货核对
What must happen before they sign the delivery receipt?
They must sell the flour.
They must open the front door.
The cracked eggs must be replaced.
The worker must order soup.
先检查数量与品质，更换破损鸡蛋后再签收。
试菜与分工
Why do they test the route between kitchen and counter?
To keep the serving passage clear and safe.
To hide the ingredients.
To start selling before they are ready.
To move the fireplace.
试走出菜路线，避免热汤与搬运人员碰撞。
晶石修复规则
What is needed to repair the crystal itself?
A larger dining table.
More coins in the ledger.
A new sign by the door.
The missing crystal fragments.
相聚稳定能量，碎片修复结构；此时尚未营业。

name: 黄昏：一盏灯的来客
intro: 试菜刚结束，莉瑟提着灯来到尚未营业的驿站。
The practice meal has just ended when Lyse arrives with her lantern. The waystation is not open yet.
outro: 三人约好只调查入口附近。夜路上，提灯成为他们共同的方向。
The three agree to inspect only the entrance. On the evening road, the lantern gives them a shared direction.
ending: 莉瑟的提灯与晶石产生共鸣。三人约定结伴调查矿道入口，遇险即撤，不深入未知区域。
dialogue: 旁白
莉瑟在门边停下，先看了墙上的菜单，再看向亮着微光的吧台。
Lyse pauses by the door, looking first at the menu and then at the faintly glowing counter.
莉瑟
你说的座位还空着吗？我想喝碗热汤，也想看看那块晶石。
Is the seat you mentioned still free? I would like some hot soup, and a look at that crystal.
陆川
座位有，汤也有。晶石不能当赠品，只能隔着吧台看。
We have seats and soup. The crystal is not a free gift, though. You can look from this side of the counter.
莉瑟
放心，我不拿走它。我的灯靠近这里时，比在集市安静。
Do not worry, I will not take it. My lantern is calmer here than it was in the market.
艾莉娅
我叫艾莉娅。陆川说你提醒他别独自去矿道，谢谢。
I am Aelia. Lu Chuan said you warned him not to enter the mine alone. Thank you.
莉瑟
莉瑟。今天我只是来借个座位，顺便确认一件事。
Lyse. Today I am here for a seat, and to check something.
旁白
一只淡紫光蝶从灯罩边升起，落在晶石裂缝旁，翅膀轻轻合拢。
A pale violet butterfly rises from the lantern and settles beside the crystal's crack, gently folding its wings.
陆川
它停在缺口边上了。你的灯认识这块晶石？
It stopped beside the missing piece. Does your lantern recognize this crystal?
莉瑟
它追踪相近的魔力，不能告诉我东西的名字。在北边，它感觉到了另一道回声。
It follows related magic, but cannot tell me an object's name. To the north, it sensed another echo.
艾莉娅
灯柄上的纹章……我曾在王室护送队的旗帜上见过。
The crest on the handle... I have seen it on the royal escort's banner.
莉瑟
请先替我保密。我不想让每个人都只听见那个身份，而不听我说什么。
Please keep that to yourself for now. I do not want everyone to hear only my title and ignore what I say.
陆川
你是来帮忙确认晶石的，不必用自己的秘密交换一碗试菜的汤。
You came to help us examine the crystal. A bowl of our practice soup does not require you to share your secrets.
莉瑟
近三晚，镇北的灯会突然熄灭。熄灭前，我的提灯都指向旧矿道。
For the last three nights, lamps in northern town have gone out suddenly. Before each blackout, my lantern pointed toward the old mine.
艾莉娅
守卫今天也报告了陌生脚印。两个线索有关，但还不能证明原因。
The guards reported unfamiliar tracks today too. The clues may be related, but do not prove the cause.
陆川
如果矿道里有碎片，灯能找到它吗？
If there is a fragment in the mine, can the lantern find it?
莉瑟
只能指方向，无法保证道路安全。我自己没有把握进去。
It can point the way, but cannot guarantee a safe path. I am not confident about going in alone.
艾莉娅
那就结伴，只看入口和第一处岔路。发现危险就撤，不追进深处。
Then we go together, only as far as the entrance and first junction. If we find danger, we retreat instead of pursuing it deeper.
陆川
我负责读标记和记录路线。你挡在前面，莉瑟负责照明和寻找回声。
I will read the markings and record our route. You take the front, while Lyse lights the way and follows the echo.
旁白
艾莉娅检查水袋和盾带。陆川把门牌留在尚未营业的一面，并写下预计返回的时间。
Aelia checks the water flask and her shield strap. Lu Chuan leaves the sign at not yet open and writes down their expected return time.
莉瑟
我会让镇门值守的人知道我们的路线。如果迟迟不回，他们至少知道去哪里找。
I will tell the gate watch our route. If we are late, they will know where to look.
陆川
先把晶石的线索查清，再回来开门。备用金和食材都留好了。
We will check the crystal clue before returning to open. Our reserve and supplies are ready.
艾莉娅
我们把退路也写清楚。能回来，比走得远更重要。
Write down our return path too. Coming back matters more than going far.
莉瑟
谢谢。有人愿意先听完我的话，比认出纹章更让我安心。
Thank you. Knowing that someone will hear me out is more reassuring than having my crest recognized.
旁白
三人沿石桥走向镇北。提灯照着脚下的路，没有催促任何人加快脚步。
The three cross the stone bridge toward the north. The lantern lights their footing without urging anyone to hurry.
questions: 来访目的
Why does Lyse visit the waystation?
To collect all its earnings.
To replace the menu.
To have soup and examine the crystal.
To recruit every guest.
莉瑟说她想喝热汤，也想查看晶石。
人物态度
How does Lu Chuan respond to Lyse's request for privacy?
He respects her choice to keep her identity private.
He demands her title before serving soup.
He announces the crest to every guest.
He refuses to let her stay.
陆川尊重莉瑟暂时保密的请求，不要求用秘密换取招待。
能力限制与行动边界
What do the three agree to do?
Follow the lantern anywhere without stopping.
Send Lyse into the mine alone.
Wait until the crystal repairs itself.
Inspect the entrance and first junction, retreating if danger appears.
提灯只指方向，不能保证安全；约定只看入口和第一处岔路，遇险撤离。
应急安排
Why will Lyse tell the gate watch their route?
To reserve more soup.
So the watch knows where to look if they return late.
To keep Aelia out of town.
So no one can follow them.
告知路线让值守人员在三人未按时返回时有明确搜寻方向。

name: 旧矿道：第一次主动出发
intro: 旧矿道的警示牌仍在。三人停在入口，先确认了退路。
The warning sign still stands outside the old mine. The three stop at the entrance and check their way back.
outro: 第一块碎晶离开了黑暗。三人没有追逐深处的回声，沿原路返回。
The first crystal fragment leaves the darkness. The three ignore the deeper echo and return along their marked route.
ending: 三人取得第一块修复碎晶，记录异常拖痕后返回。更深处的调查留待准备充分之后。
dialogue: 旁白
入口的铁栏半掩着，地面散落碎石。艾莉娅先用盾沿探了探脚下。
The iron gate stands partly open, with loose stones scattered below. Aelia tests the ground with the edge of her shield.
艾莉娅
站在我身后，别踩右侧松动的石板。我们先确认出口一直可见。
Stay behind me and avoid the loose slab on the right. First, make sure the exit remains in sight.
陆川
木牌写着“西道通风，东道塌陷”。箭头有些褪色，字还看得清。
The sign reads, 'West passage ventilated; east passage collapsed.' The arrows are faded, but the words are clear.
莉瑟
提灯偏向西边。可它只告诉我们方向，不能替我们判断那条路。
The lantern leans west. It gives us a direction, but cannot judge the passage for us.
艾莉娅
西边有风，先看西道。每过一个转角留个标记，塌陷的东道不进。
There is airflow to the west. We inspect that passage first. Mark every turn, and stay out of the collapsed eastern one.
旁白
陆川在入口石壁上画下箭头，记录了第一处转角与出口的位置。
Lu Chuan draws an arrow on the entrance wall, noting the first turn and the position of the exit.
旁白
低矮的影子从废矿车下扑出。艾莉娅举盾，金属撞击声在石壁间回荡。
A low shape lunges from beneath an abandoned cart. Aelia raises her shield, and the impact echoes between the stone walls.
艾莉娅
别往后乱跑！左侧空着，陆川，帮我照清它的落点。
Do not run blindly backward! The left side is clear. Lu Chuan, help me see where it lands.
陆川
卡牌上的“牵制”不是攻击。我先限制它移动，你再把它挡开。
The card says 'restrain', not 'attack'. I will limit its movement, then you can push it back.
莉瑟
灯放左边，不照你的眼睛。它又要扑了！
I will hold the light to the left, away from your eyes. It is about to leap again!
旁白
言契束住怪物的前爪，艾莉娅用盾将它逼回废矿车后。三人重新站稳。
The word pact binds the creature's front claws. Aelia drives it behind the cart with her shield, and the three regain their footing.
艾莉娅
够了，不追。它退开了，我们继续看岔路前的石台。
That is enough. Do not chase it. It has withdrawn; we will inspect the stone ledge before the junction.
陆川
这里的拖痕都朝着石台，不像随便路过。它们可能在找同一个东西。
These drag marks all lead toward the ledge. They do not look random. The creatures may be searching for the same thing.
莉瑟
光蝶停在石缝上了。缝里有一块晶体，颜色和你们吧台上的一样。
The butterfly has stopped over a crack in the rock. There is a crystal inside, the same color as the one on your counter.
艾莉娅
先别伸手。石台底下还有动静，我来挡住。
Do not reach in yet. Something is moving beneath the ledge. I will hold it back.
陆川
标记旁边写着“先松扣，再抬盖”。硬拉会把石缝压紧。
The marking says, 'Release the catch before lifting the cover.' Pulling it directly will tighten the gap.
莉瑟
我找到了扣环。按说明来，晶体没有卡住了。
I found the catch. Following the instructions has freed the crystal.
旁白
莉瑟取出碎晶，用布包好。提灯的光缩成一圈，绕在她掌心。
Lyse lifts out the fragment and wraps it in cloth. The lantern's light gathers into a circle around her palm.
旁白
石台下的守卫兽撞向盾面。艾莉娅退半步站稳，陆川再次展开牵制卡。
The guardian beneath the ledge strikes the shield. Aelia steadies herself a step back as Lu Chuan opens the restraint card again.
艾莉娅
碎片拿到了，沿标记退！我挡最后一下，不需要在这里打到底。
We have the fragment. Follow the marks out! I will block once more. We do not need to fight to the end here.
陆川
原路两处箭头，出口在转角左边。莉瑟先走，我跟着，艾莉娅断后。
Two arrows on our return route; the exit is left after the turn. Lyse goes first, then me, with Aelia covering the rear.
莉瑟
深处还有回声……但我们答应过只看第一处岔路。今天不追了。
There is another echo deeper inside... but we agreed to stop at the first junction. We leave it today.
艾莉娅
回去把拖痕的位置交给守卫。下次来，得有地图和更多准备。
We will report the marks to the guards. Next time, we need a map and better preparation.
旁白
三人走出铁栏时，夜风吹散了石尘。陆川回头确认，每个人都在。
As they step past the iron gate, the night breeze clears the stone dust. Lu Chuan looks back to make sure everyone is there.
questions: 路径判断
Why do they inspect the western passage first?
It has airflow, while the eastern passage is marked as collapsed.
The eastern passage leads straight to the tavern.
They want to hide the exit.
The lantern guarantees that no danger exists.
路牌提示西道通风、东道塌陷，提灯不能代替安全判断。
协作与卡牌含义
How does Lu Chuan help during the first encounter?
He chases the creature into the depths.
He replaces Aelia's shield.
He extinguishes the lantern.
He restricts the creature's movement so Aelia can push it back.
牵制卡限制移动，艾莉娅以盾逼退怪物；没有追击。
操作顺序
What must they do before lifting the cover?
Pull harder on the crystal.
Release the catch.
Move into the collapsed passage.
Break the lantern.
说明明确要求先松扣，再抬盖，硬拉反而压紧石缝。
行动目的与撤退
Why do they return instead of following the deeper echo?
They have lost the fragment.
The inn no longer needs repairs.
They have the fragment and agreed to limit this investigation.
The guards ordered them to abandon the town.
已取得碎晶，遵守只调查入口与第一岔路的约定，准备充分后再探索深处。

name: 夜晚：第一次营业
intro: 三人带着碎晶回到尚未开门的驿站。修复晶石后，他们将迎来第一批客人。
The three return to the unopened waystation with a crystal fragment. After repairing the crystal, they will welcome their first customers.
outro: 第一次营业留下了六枚铜币的盈余。晶石的光稳定下来，更深的裂痕仍等待修复。
Their first service leaves a profit of six copper coins. The crystal shines steadily, but its deeper cracks still need repair.
ending: 晶石第一道裂痕修复，首次营业完成结算。艾莉娅留下，莉瑟约定再来；陆川得知她的王室身份。
dialogue: 旁白
陆川洗净手上的石尘，莉瑟将包着碎晶的布放在吧台中央。
Lu Chuan washes the stone dust from his hands. Lyse sets the wrapped fragment in the middle of the counter.
艾莉娅
门牌还没翻。先把碎片放到裂口旁，确认安全以后再开门。
The sign has not been turned yet. Place the fragment beside the crack, and we will open once it is safe.
陆川
形状刚好能对上。它好像自己在往缺口里靠。
The shape matches. It seems to be moving toward the gap on its own.
旁白
碎晶融入第一道裂痕，微光沿着石面慢慢铺开。更深的裂缝仍清晰可见。
The fragment joins the first crack, and light spreads slowly across the surface. Deeper fractures remain clearly visible.
言契系统
第一处结构修复完成。封印趋于稳定，尚未完全恢复。
The first structural repair is complete. The seal is becoming stable, but is not fully restored.
莉瑟
光蝶不再绕着这个缺口打转了。至少今天，我们找对了一块。
The butterfly no longer circles this gap. At least today, we found the right piece.
旁白
开门之前，三人在桌边坐下。陆川将空白订单簿摊开，先说明自己为什么要经营这间酒馆。
Before opening, the three sit around a table. Lu Chuan opens the blank order book and explains why he needs to run the tavern.
陆川
女神把我送到这里，是因为这间驿站的晶石维系着地面封印。地下的魔王还被困着，可封印已经开始衰弱。
The goddess sent me here because this waystation's crystal maintains the seal above ground. The demon king is still trapped below, but the seal is weakening.
陆川
她说，人们在这里休息、交谈、互相帮助，形成的共鸣能为晶石供能。找回碎片是修复结构，开门营业则是维持能量。
She said that people resting, talking, and helping one another here create resonance that supplies the crystal with energy. Fragments repair its structure; running the tavern maintains its power.
艾莉娅
明白了。我们不能只找碎片，也不能只把桌子摆好。要让这里真正成为有人愿意停下来的地方。
I understand. We cannot just collect fragments or arrange the tables. This needs to become a place where people actually want to stop and rest.
陆川
对。封印稳定以后，女神才能为我打开安全的归途。在那之前，我也希望路过的人能在这里安心吃顿饭。
Exactly. Once the seal is stable, the goddess can open a safe route home for me. Until then, I want travelers to be able to enjoy a meal here without fear.
莉瑟
我也明白了。让旅人聚在一起，同时守住镇子的安全……今晚我愿意帮忙。晶石的线索，我们以后继续查。
I understand too. Bringing travelers together also helps keep the town safe. I would like to help tonight, and we can continue investigating the crystal afterward.
艾莉娅
那我负责厨房。先把汤重新热好，准备面包；客人有忌口，先告诉我。做好的餐放到出餐处，再叫你来端。

Then I will handle the kitchen. I will reheat the soup and prepare the bread. Tell me about any dietary restrictions first. When the food is ready, I will place it at the serving counter and call you.
莉瑟
我在吧台记单。桌号、份数、特殊要求，还有是否打包，逐项写清，再把订单交给厨房。
I will record orders at the bar: the table number, portions, special requests, and whether the food is to go. Then I will pass each order to the kitchen.
陆川
我负责从厨房端菜到桌边。端走前核对桌号和要求，送到以后再确认一次，空碗也由我带回来。
I will carry the finished food from the kitchen to the tables. I will check the table number and requests before leaving, confirm them again when serving, and bring back the empty bowls.
艾莉娅
顺序就是：吧台记单，厨房备餐，出餐后送到对应的桌子。门口和厨房通道都不能堆东西；忙不过来就先说。
The sequence is simple: record the order at the bar, prepare it in the kitchen, and serve it at the correct table. Keep the entrance and kitchen passage clear. Speak up if you need help.
莉瑟
记住了。我先记清订单；忙的时候可以帮忙打包，但不会把还没核对的单子留在一边。
Understood. I will record each order carefully. When it gets busy, I can help pack the bread, but I will not leave an unchecked order behind.
陆川
好。我先端汤，忙的时候我们再互相补位。今晚先把这几张桌子照顾好，账本等客人吃完再算。
Good. I will start by serving the soup, and we can help each other when needed. Tonight, let us take care of these tables first. We can settle the accounts after the guests have eaten.
旁白
陆川洗净手，艾莉娅重新热好汤。莉瑟点亮桌灯，门牌第一次翻到营业的一面。
Lu Chuan washes his hands, and Aelia reheats the soup. Lyse lights the table lamps, and the sign turns to open for the first time.
旁白
送货人收工后回来，两名巡逻守卫随后进门。准备好的四张圆桌终于迎来了客人。
The delivery worker returns after his work, followed by two patrol guards. The four prepared round tables finally welcome customers.
送货人
一碗不加鸡蛋的汤，两片面包带走。我记得你说过，准备好了才开门。
One bowl of soup without eggs, and two slices of bread to take away. I remember you said you would open only when ready.
陆川
汤不加鸡蛋，面包打包。今晚是第一次营业，谢谢你愿意来。
Soup without eggs, bread packed to go. This is our first service. Thank you for coming.
艾莉娅
我来装面包，你先端汤。门口和厨房的通道都留空，照我们试过的顺序来。
I will pack the bread while you serve the soup. Keep the entrance and kitchen passage clear, and follow the order we practiced.
旁白
碗勺声和谈笑声渐渐填满大厅。晶石的微光稳定下来，但没有新的裂缝自行消失。
Spoons and conversation gradually fill the hall. The crystal glows steadily, but no further crack disappears on its own.
陆川
接下来是账本。今日营业收了二十四枚铜币，食材成本十八枚。
Next, the ledger. Today's sales brought in twenty-four copper coins. Ingredients cost eighteen.
艾莉娅
那是六枚盈余，不是二十四枚。明天还要进货，别把收入全当能花的钱。
That leaves six in profit, not twenty-four. We need supplies tomorrow, so do not treat all revenue as spending money.
陆川
记下了，成本和收入分开。我还留着采购后剩下的十二枚备用金。
Noted: keep costs and revenue separate. I still have the twelve coins left from our supply budget.
莉瑟
第一天能算清楚，比第一天就赚大钱可靠。你们明天还开门吗？
Clear accounts on day one are more reliable than a fortune. Will you be open tomorrow?
陆川
开。先保留今天的菜单，不能因为卖完一锅汤就假装自己是大厨。
Yes. We will keep today's menu. Selling one pot of soup does not make me a master chef.
艾莉娅
也把矿道记录抄一份。明早交给值守官，不把危险只留在我们自己的本子里。
Copy the mine notes too. We will give them to the watch officer tomorrow, rather than keeping the danger in our own notebook.
旁白
门外传来车轮声，一位披深色斗篷的侍从在门廊下停住。
Wheels sound outside. An attendant in a dark cloak stops beneath the porch.
侍从
殿下，马车已备好。您让我们等到的时刻已经到了。
Your Highness, the carriage is ready. The hour you asked us to wait for has arrived.
陆川
殿下？所以灯柄上的纹章，不是买灯时附送的装饰。
Your Highness? So the crest on the handle was not decoration included with the lamp.
莉瑟
不是。对不起，今天先说了一个能让我自在些的名字。
No. I am sorry. Today I used a name that gave me a little freedom.
陆川
你告诉我们的灯和矿道都是真的。名字的另一半，等你想说时再说。
What you told us about the lantern and mine was true. The rest of your name can wait until you want to share it.
莉瑟
谢谢。下次我还是想坐今天这个位置，喝你们的汤。
Thank you. Next time, I would still like this seat and a bowl of your soup.
旁白
马车越过石桥。艾莉娅收好最后一只杯子，陆川将门牌翻到打烊的一面。
The carriage crosses the stone bridge. Aelia puts away the last cup, and Lu Chuan turns the sign to 'closed'.
艾莉娅
如果你还需要人守着这里，我明天也在。不是只等屋顶修好的那一天。
If you still need someone to guard this place, I will be here tomorrow too. I was not waiting only for the roof to be repaired.
陆川
需要。明天的分工还是一起商量，今天就先好好休息。
I do. We will plan tomorrow together. Tonight, let us get some rest.
旁白
账本里夹着采购单、第一批订单和矿道记录。直到这一晚，驿站才真正完成第一次营业。
The ledger holds the shopping list, the first paid orders, and the mine notes. Only tonight has the waystation completed its first service.
陆川
门口那盏灯留着吧。要是有人夜里路过，至少知道这里还有个归处。
Leave the light by the door on. If someone passes at night, they will know there is still a place to return to.
旁白
地下深处，一道低语穿过黑暗：“那间驿站……又亮起来了。”
Deep underground, a whisper travels through the darkness: 'That waystation... it is shining again.'
questions: 修复进度
What changes after the fragment joins the crystal?
Every fracture disappears at once.
The first crack is repaired, but deeper fractures remain.
The seal loses all its energy.
The lantern becomes a cooking tool.
第一道裂痕修复完成，封印更稳定，但尚未完全恢复。
账目理解
What is the profit from the day's sales after ingredient costs?
Twenty-four copper coins.
Eighteen copper coins.
Six copper coins.
Thirty copper coins.
营业收入二十四枚减食材成本十八枚，盈余六枚；备用金不是营业利润。
身份线索与信任
What reveals Lyse's royal identity to Lu Chuan?
Her purchase of vegetables.
Her refusal to pay for soup.
A new menu on the wall.
The attendant addresses her as 'Your Highness'.
侍从称她为殿下，陆川由此确认王室身份，并尊重她保留姓名细节。
章末人物意愿
What does Aelia decide at the end of the day?
To remain and help guard the waystation.
To leave before the next morning.
To close the mine by herself that night.
To take Lyse's carriage without asking.
艾莉娅明确表示明天也会留下，继续守护驿站。
